name: SAVVY-Bench
description: SAVVY-Bench is a curated evaluation suite hosted on Hugging Face intended to measure model performance on practical reasoning/knowledge tasks (dataset metadata and exact tasks vary by release). It contains a mixture of prompt-style items that evaluate factual knowledge and commonsense reasoning in short textual formats. The dataset is relatively new and aimed at accessible, reproducible benchmarking for text models.
reputation: A small, community-contributed benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing visibility.
